text: For the leader; with stringed instruments. Of David.
I Hear my cry, O God,listen to my prayer!
From the ends of the earth [1] I call;my heart grows faint.Raise me up, set me on a rock,
for you are my refuge,a tower of strength against the foe. [AA]
Let me dwell in your tent forever,take refuge in the shelter of your wings. [AB]Selah
II For you, O God, have heard my vows,you have granted me the heritage of those who revere your name.
Add days to the life of the king;may his years be as from generation to generation; [AC]
t[AD] May he reign before God forever;send your love and fidelity [2] to preserve him— [AE]
I will duly sing to your name forever,fulfill my vows day after day.
